programs.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
programs.desc: A twisted mastermind uses homemade bombs to terrorize the nation. Despite one of the most extensive manhunts in U.S. history, he still manages to stay one step ahead of law enforcement for nearly two decades. How did investigators finally catch "The Unabomber," and bring one of America's most elusive criminals to justice?

programs.desc: During World War Two, the Nazis stole vast amounts of art, gold, silver and currency, and stashed it across Europe; while some of the plunder has been recovered, much more is still missing nearly 80 years later.

programs.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
programs.desc: One of World War II's greatest unsolved mysteries: an incomparable work of art worth half a billion dollars, lost without a trace; perhaps the single most valuable object the Nazis ever stole, the quest for this treasure has lasted over 75 years.

programs.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
programs.desc: During World War II, a fiery phenomenon terrorizes American airmen in the night skies over Europe; the pilots call these fireballs "Foo Fighters," and swear they move at over 200 mph and defy the laws of physics. But what are they?

programs.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
programs.sub_title: The Search for Rommel's Gold: WWII Edition
programs.desc: One of Germany's top military minds during WWII, General Erwin Rommel The Desert Fox, tears through North Africa; as he captures territory, and imprisons local Jews in camps, he steals their gold and valuables in the name of the Führer; but when the allies surrender, that wealth is nowhere to be found; for decades, many have looked for this elusive treasure. What became of Rommel's gold?
